changes.approvalIdentity: Initial directory identity is captured before input reads, used for approval comparison and carried unchanged into the held-parent guard.
changes.anchoredWrites: The exclusive attempt and all phase receipts are written through the already-reviewed held-parent implementation.
changes.cleanup: Execution, provisional-receipt and directory-close errors are preserved separately; any uncertain cleanup or final deadline failure prevents acceptance.
changes.finalReceipt: The on-disk pre-close outcome is explicitly provisional and cannot claim final completion. The bounded final CLI result is emitted after directory cleanup.
changes.compatibility: Prepared inputs retain three-value unpacking. The CLI error response explicitly retains false production and native-compatibility flags.
changes.sourceClosure: Four fixed assembly slots change: driver, setup profile, setup and receiver. The latter two retain their executable logic and change fixed digest literals only.
changes.businessPolicyAstComparison: Original execution-policy body retained apart from prepared-input forwarding and moving final receipt ownership into the held-close wrapper.

coverage: actual parent descriptor closure before final acceptance
close failure and provisional receipt failure prevent success
execution and close errors remain distinguishable at the CLI
bounded nested error formatting without exception bodies
private marker mount request and D-Bus encoding
unchanged setup guards using explicit memory and manager doubles
actual inactive saved entry refusal and owned process cleanup

review.scope: independent source, diff, hash and test-source review

limitations: 46 is the scoped private candidate suite, not a new complete product regression.
Actual Linux tmpfs mounts, read-only flags, bus reachability and effective resource restrictions remain unverified.
A downstream frozen controller has a similar private runtime-directory compatibility boundary that still needs evaluation before whole-chain acceptance.
Earlier failed evidence and the pre-fix inactive package are retained; they are not executable candidates.
